title: Sony Vietnam — Brand Awareness & Lead Gen
summary: Brand awareness campaigns and performance lead generation for Sony Vietnam across electronics product lines.
description:
Supported Sony Vietnam's digital marketing team in planning and executing awareness and lead-gen campaigns for the consumer electronics division. Key categories included audio, cameras, and television product lines.

Managed Meta and Google display campaigns targeting tech-enthusiast segments. Handled creative briefing, media planning, and performance reporting.

Internalized D2C marketing principles and contributed to a cross-channel playbook later adopted as the standard operating procedure for product launch campaigns.
